overview: PondyOne is a hyper-local three-tier marketplace for Puducherry and Chennai with separate interfaces for Customers, Business Owners, and Admins. Features hotel stay bookings with date-based pricing, turf time-slot grid booking, retail delivery fees, SaaS subscription enforcement for owners, and rich booking history for customers.
features: Stay bookings with check-in/check-out dates and duration-based pricing
Turf slot grid with owner-managed time blocks and booked status
Retail delivery fee calculated by flat rate per km based on customer distance
SaaS subscription enforcement with UPI verification and account activation
Clickable booking history with full detail view for customers
Three-tier role system: Customer, Business Owner, Founder Admin
UPI-first checkout with manual transaction ID
Owner analytics dashboard with time-period selector
Admin hard delete for users and owners
PWA installable with PWABuilder APK support
